jobStory.zh: 当患者需要就诊时，希望查看可用医生和时间段并预约，以便按时完成诊疗
jobStory.en: When a patient needs medical care, they want to view available doctors and time slots and schedule an appointment to complete treatment on time.

pain.zh: 已预约的时段无法被其他患者占用，导致资源浪费或患者错过就诊机会
pain.en: Booked appointment slots cannot be reserved by other patients, causing resource waste or missed visits.

workaround.en: Assuming patients must manually coordinate doctors' availability or wait for free slots, without system-enforced exclusivity.

rootObstacle.zh: 系统缺乏对已预约时段的排他性锁定机制，导致资源冲突
rootObstacle.en: The system lacks an exclusive locking mechanism for booked time slots, causing resource conflicts.

build.zh: 实现已预约时段的数字锁功能，禁止其他用户同时预订同一时段
build.en: Build a digital lock feature that prevents other users from booking the same scheduled time slot.

stopIf.zh: 测试中多个账户可同时成功预订同一时段，说明排他性机制缺失
stopIf.en: If multiple accounts can successfully book the same slot simultaneously, it indicates the exclusivity mechanism is missing.

whyNow.zh: 该问题直接导致患者流失，是提升用户留存的关键痛点
whyNow.en: This issue directly causes patient churn and is a critical pain point for improving retention.
